judged_text: The ZAddGuestsInputSchema (array of emails plus uniqueness refinement) is hand-duplicated in the dialog component instead of importing the single ZAddGuestsInputSchema from addGuests.schema.ts, creating parallel client/server schemas that can drift. A future change to the server schema (e.g., max guest count or stricter email rule) will not be reflected in the dialog, so the client will submit payloads the server rejects or block payloads the server accepts; the next editor must update two files in two packages to change one rule.

This is a real, diff-grounded maintainability/architecture issue: client and server validation rules are now split across files/packages and can drift if server-side constraints change, though it’s not a verifiable runtime defect from the diff alone.
